title: Eval acceptance blueprint: cohorted sentinel thresholds & adaptive rollback gates
creator: Aisha Kumar
summary: Deliver a prescriptive acceptance blueprint for Optimize evals that defines cohorted promptset sampling, multi-signal regression thresholds, staged A/B criteria, and deterministic rollback gates. The blueprint will be used by PM/Eng/Research to sign off model rollouts and automate early stopping in Console/Automations.
background: Current Optimize rollouts rely on ad-hoc signal checks and hand-tuned thresholds per model. This creates inconsistent behavior across customers and slows time-to-rollout. We need a reproducible decision framework that balances sensitivity to regressions with tolerance for stochastic noise, ties to actionability, and integrates with canary traffic shaping and automated rollback policies.
goals: 1) Define cohorting rules for prompt sets (surface/long-tail/prioritized customers). 2) Specify composite regression thresholds across accuracy/coverage/cost/latency/safety signals. 3) Define A/B passing criteria (statistical and minimum effect sizes) for progressive rollouts. 4) Produce deterministic rollback and pause triggers mapped to remediation actions.
out_of_scope: Per-model policy tuning; implementation work in runtime. This ticket focuses on requirements and acceptance rules; engineering implementation will be separate.
requirements:
- Promptset partitioning: primary cohorts, long-tail cohorts, and sentinel examples; sampling schema with minimum N per cohort.
- Metric set: utility (task-specific pass rate), semantic similarity (embedding median), safety (toxicity/factuality sentinels), latency (p50/p95), and cost-per-1K-tokens.
- Composite signal engine: ability to compute weighted z-scores across signals and generate a composite regression score.
- Tiered action levels (observe, throttle, pause, rollback) with clear mapping to composite score and per-signal thresholds.
- A/B test requirements: minimum N, confidence interval method, required directionality, and minimum effect size for actionability.
- Canary windows: staged traffic ramps with minimum observation windows and gating rules that can be automated from Console.
- Auditability: every decision should record the signals, thresholds hit, and sampled prompts leading to action for postmortem.
sampling_strategy:
- Primary promptset: stratified sampling across top 10 intents; target 2k prompts per roll.
- Long-tail: reservoir sample of 5k low-frequency queries aggregated weekly.
- Sentinels: a curated list of 250 high-risk prompts (safety/factuality/business) run on every candidate.
- Live traffic shadowing: 48h of shadowed requests with at least 10k tokens processed before canary.
- Minimum per-cohort N: primary 2000, long-tail 5000, sentinel 250. If a cohort cannot meet N, escalate to manual review.
metrics_and_thresholds:
Composite score calculation: z-normalize each signal by historical baseline window (28d) and compute weighted sum using weights: utility 0.45, safety 0.25, latency 0.15, cost 0.10, similarity 0.05.
Action thresholds (example defaults): Observe if composite delta > 0.5 sd; Throttle if composite delta > 1.0 sd OR any safety signal delta above 3% absolute increase for top-10 safety predicates; Pause if composite delta > 1.8 sd AND at least one cohort shows >2 sd degradation; Rollback immediate if any safety predicate exceeds absolute threshold (e.g., toxic content recall >0.5% increase) OR utility pass-rate drops by >5% absolute across primary cohort with p<0.01.
A/B pass criteria: two-sided bootstrap CI 95% on primary utility metric; require p<0.01 and minimum effect size of 2% absolute improvement for promotion. If p between 0.01-0.05 and effect size >3%, route to manual escalation.
Latency/cost caps: p95 latency increase must be <15% and cost/per-1k must not rise >10% in production compared to baseline; otherwise treat as throttle-level event.
ab_test_plan:
- Lift-based A/B for generation quality on primary promptset.
- Minimum sample: 10k effective prompts per variant (effective = prompts with evaluable ground truth).
- Analysis windows: primary canary 72h with continuous monitoring; staged ramp to 25%, 50%, 100% if passing gates.
- Statistical method: block bootstrap by user/session to account for correlation.
- Decisions: explicit pass/fail recorded in Console; failed canary triggers automated throttle to previous stable variant.
canary_and_rollback_triggers:
- Canary stage 1 (5% traffic, 24h min): automated monitor; if composite >1.0 sd OR any safety sentinel breach -> pause ramp and run deep sample analysis.
- Canary stage 2 (25% traffic, 48h min): require A/B criteria satisfied; if composite >1.8 sd or safety breach -> rollback.
- Emergency rollback: immediate on any safety predicate exceeding absolute threshold or if utility drops >10% absolute in any cohort.
- Soft rollback: reduce traffic by 80% and engage SRE + PM for 2h triage if throttle-level triggers persist beyond observation window.
- All automated rollbacks must create an incident with attached signal snapshots and sampled prompts.
dashboard_and_alerts:
- Console dashboard: composite score timeseries, cohort breakdown, per-signal deltas, sampled failing prompts.
- Alerts: severity levels mapped to action tiers; P0 (immediate rollback), P1 (pause/attention), P2 (investigate).
- Alert routing: P0 -> on-call SRE + PM; P1 -> PM + owning engineer; P2 -> engineering triage channel.
- Retention: signals and sampled prompts retained for 90 days for postmortem.
data_and_instrumentation:
- Required events: evaluated_prompt_id, cohort_tag, ground_truth_label (if available), model_version, tokens_in/out, latency_ms, embedding_distance, safety_predicates_hit.
- Logging schema: JSON lines with deterministic field names; must support sampling export to BigQuery and attach to incident.
- Baseline window: 28-day rolling baseline stored daily for z-normalization.
- Privacy: sampled prompts must be scrubbed per PII guidelines before persist (use redaction library).
acceptance_criteria:
1) Documented sampling schema and sentinel list reviewed and approved by Research and Safety.
2) Composite score definition validated on last three model rollouts with simulated detection of known regressions (test vectors included).
3) A/B analysis notebook and statistical test scripts committed to repo.
4) Console mockup showing composite score and cohort filters approved by Console PM.
5) Automation hooks defined for canary stages and rollback triggers with clear API contract for Eng.
6) Security review completed and data retention plan signed off.
milestones:
- M1 (2025-02-24): finalize sentinel list and sampling schema.
- M2 (2025-02-28): composite score formula + simulated validation.
- M3 (2025-03-05): A/B analysis cookbook + notebook.
- M4 (2025-03-12): Console gating mock + automation API spec.
- M5 (2025-03-20): signoffs (Research, Safety, Security, Console).
dependencies_notes: Depends on: instrumentation pipeline work from Eng (ENG-50812), Console gating API (ENG-52199), and Safety predicate expansion (Research-990). Need security review for prompt retention (InfoSec).
risks_and_mitigation:
- False positives: mitigate with multi-signal composite and minimum effect size.
- Low sample volume in niche cohorts: escalate to manual gating and require more shadow traffic.
- Automation misfires: all automated rollbacks to require incident creation and human acknowledgement before permanent variant deletion.
notes_and_decisions:
- Decision: Use z-score weighting with asymmetric action windows (more sensitive to safety regressions).
- Decision: Sentinel list will be versioned and reviewed quarterly.
- Tradeoff: stricter safety thresholds increase rollback frequency; mitigated via staging and manual escalation windows.
